SELECT ci.id, ci.code, approve_status, seller_name, approve_user_name, ci.name, short_name, ci.disabled, use_org_name, group_id, group_name, use_org_id, ci.create_user_name, ci.create_time, ci.platform_type as platformType, currency, financial_organization, enable_time, down_time, trade_currency, business_mode, transactional_mode, period_setting, check_type, ci.country_id, ccp.partition_id as partitionId, ccp.partition_code as partitionCode, ccp.partition_name as partitionName, ci.sales_dept_id as salesDeptId FROM customer_info ci left join foreign_cfg_country_partition ccp on ccp.id = ci.partition_id and ccp.is_deleted = false and ccp.disabled = false WHERE
${params.sqlMap.default} and ci.is_deleted=FALSE
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY ci.create_time DESC
select id,"name", code,group_id,group_name from customer_info ci where ci.is_deleted = FALSE and group_id != '' ORDER BY group_name

SELECT ci.id, ci.code, ci.name, ca.address AS receiveAddress, ca.person AS receiverName, ca.tel_number AS telNumber FROM customer_info ci LEFT JOIN customer_address ca ON ci.id = ca.main_id AND ca.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE ci.is_deleted = FALSE
AND ci.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}::text, '%')
ORDER BY ca.is_default desc limit 1

select id, name,short_name,code , approve_status ,disabled,currency,use_org_id from ( select ci.id, ci.code, ci.short_name, ci.name, ci.approve_status, ci.disabled, ci.currency, ci.use_org_id from customer_info ci where ci.is_deleted = FALSE and ci.approve_status = 'approve' and ci.disabled = FALSE
and ((ci.id=#{params.searchKeyword} or ci.code = #{params.searchKeyword}) or ci.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%') or ci.short_name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by
case when ci.name ILIKE concat(#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 1 when ci.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text) THEN 2 when ci.name ILIKE concat('%',#{params.searchKeyword}::text,'%') THEN 3 end , ci.name,
code desc ) custom
